name: write/summary
title: Summarise a long document
summary: Summarise a long file or document: index it, read it section by section, keep figures exact, state what was left out.
when: Use when a file or document is too long to read whole and the user wants its content summarised.
steps: Call doc_add with path set to the document so doc_search and doc_read can open it.
Call doc_list with document left empty to get its handle, then with document set to the handle for its heading outline.
Call doc_read with document set to the handle, chunk 1 and count 3, then raise chunk by 3 until the end.
Call study_file with path and question for one long plain text file, and keep the part numbers it returns.
Copy every figure, name and date exactly as printed, with the heading it came under.
Call doc_search with query set to a term and limit 5 when a section you need never appeared in the chunks read.
If doc_add refuses the format, call read_file with path and start and end line numbers, and say the rest was not read.
Answer in the document's own order in a few short paragraphs, keep figures exact, and name the sections left out.
next: The final answer must summarise the document in its own order with every figure exact and one line naming the sections that were left out.
